invariant: CommandLinkClass resolves a relationship endpoint through the existing quark tree before creating a missing class leaf, and an existing group remains the endpoint entity whether it is empty or contains children. SVEK converts a directly empty group into its package leaf while preserving the group UID. For a filled group, Bibliotekon#getNodeUid selects Cluster#getSpecialPointId and ClusterDotString emits that point inside the cluster before routing the edge. SVG endpoint metadata uses the group's own short quark name rather than its fully qualified nesting path.
causal_divergence: Rust now resolves existing packages in the parser but only maps directly empty package leaves to layout nodes and UIDs. A filled package endpoint is left as a non-node cluster name, so the relationship cannot reproduce Java's internal special point. Nested package endpoints also serialize the fully qualified Rust path where Java reports the short group name. The first attempt therefore passed top-level empty controls but failed valid nested and filled-group counterparts.
planned_change: Treat every existing package as a group endpoint in the class model. Keep directly empty packages mapped to their converted leaf node; create and attach a SVEK cluster endpoint point for rendered clusters using LayoutGraph's existing group-endpoint mechanism; map both forms to the package UID; and derive relationship metadata from the package's short identity component. Preserve current class creation only for genuinely missing endpoints.
